base_eye_consistency.interpretation: No abrupt low-power mechanism discontinuity was observed across the two base eyes.

epd3_wavefront_signatures.WFS: delta C4 positive and delta C6 negative across A0V12/B0V12/C0V12 and both base eyes
epd3_wavefront_signatures.RAD: dominant negative delta C6 with small positive delta C4 across A0V12/B0V12/C0V12 and both base eyes
epd3_wavefront_signatures.HOA: delta C4 negative and delta C6 positive across A0V12/B0V12/C0V12 and both base eyes

tradeoff.interpretation: EDOF residuals redistribute through-focus quality rather than producing a free gain.

dof50.interpretation: Far-censored EDOF DOF50 values are lower bounds and must not be treated as exact widths.

distance_peak.interpretation: Boundary peaks at -0.50 D are censored locations, not exact peak estimates.

scientific_caveats: Five EDOF pairs have far-censored DOF50; their DOF50 is a lower bound within the frozen window.
Eight EDOF EPD5 pairs have distance-peak censoring at the frozen -0.50 D boundary.
Several uncensored EPD5 delta-DOF50 effects are near zero and can change sign between base eyes; these should not be overinterpreted as stable directional effects.
Absolute TASK-007/TASK-013/TASK-014 DOF50 or peak-shift values are not asserted to be numerically interchangeable; mechanism direction and wavefront signature are the comparison targets.
